relations.claim: 连续拦截后球权转换或导向扳平进攻

story_context.summary: 扳平前主角队连续完成拦截夺回球权，或为最后进攻的组织起点。
falsification_conditions: 若三次拦截均发生在主角队防守半场则进攻起点假设不成立

narrative_purpose: This proposal is the most compact and temporally adjacent to the equalizer window (6403.81s–6410.07s vs equalizer buildup at ~6442s). The three interceptions are all non-replay footage events and the observation query targets whether the final interception (event_000636) initiates forward progression toward the equalizer. This directly addresses the unresolved question of whether the buildup-to-equalizer transition has omitted causal state. Other proposals either rely on replay-flagged VAR footage (interval_01:H1), misattribute team sides (interval_01:H2, H4), or lack interleaved opponent even
